messages:
Marta (CS): quick heads-up — Lucent Health's analytics org just opened a new intake. They want org-wide embeddings + realtime summarization for clinical notes. Renewal is 28 days out, so this could turn into an expansion opportunity or a pricing negotiation risk.
Jordan (AE): nice — any hard numbers on traffic?
Marta (CS): saw a sudden jump in calls this morning. pinging the usage snapshot:```last_24h:
  /embeddings  requests: 42k (baseline 4k)
  /chat/realtime  qps: peak 38, p50 120ms, p95 560ms
  tokens/day: ~4.8M (normal ~1.1M)```
Rahul (SE): whoa that's a 4x token spike. Do we know if they're batching or doing small vector calls? also region?
Marta (CS): appears split across us-east and eu-west; embeddings are small vectors (512 dim) but called very frequently from a new analytics pipeline. No batching.
Emi (Onboarding): I can run a quick enablement with their infra team — get them to use prefix caching and client-side batching. What nights work for Lucent?
Jordan (AE): cc @Rahul — for renewal playbook: if we can convert the analytics team into a paid seat for Dedicated, we can offset the extra usage. I'd like a recommendation on capacity + cost delta so I can propose ARR math.
Rahul (SE): suggest two options: (1) short-term throttle + advise batching + apply caching rules (fast) (2) Dedicated pool + quantized model for embeddings (medium-term). I'll draft numbers — need their sample prompt/payload distribution.
Marta (CS): requested sample payloads from their infra contact (Anita). ETA 3 hours.
Emi (Onboarding): penciling in a 30m enablement slot tomorrow 9am PT. If they accept, I’ll cover batching best practices and demo server-side caching.
Jordan (AE): can we get capacity-bot to show current pod headroom in us-east/eu-west? need to know if we can absorb a sustained 4x.
capacity-bot: current capacity snapshot:
  us-east: GPU pools 12/20 used (headroom 8)
  eu-west: GPU pools 9/12 used (headroom 3)
  queued jobs: 2
  est available qps for chat: us-east ~120, eu-west ~45
Marta (CS): thanks — eu-west looks tight. Rahul, if we recommend Dedicated, can you include eu-west sizing + expected latency improvement?
Rahul (SE): on it. I'll put together a short pros/cons + rough cost delta and post by EOD.
Jordan (AE): I'll hold renewal conversation light until we know their appetite. If they want a pilot for Dedicated, I'll prep commercial terms.
Marta (CS): also flagging potential churn risk if we don't manage costs — they asked if current spend will increase. I'll draft an email that couples an enablement offer + pilot suggestion.
Emi (Onboarding): sending tentative invite now.
Marta (CS): thanks all. tagging next steps: @Rahul cost + sizing, @Emi enablement, @Jordan renewal positioning. Will update thread when Anita shares payloads. :eyes:
